title: The Voynich Manuscript: The Book Nobody Can Read
description: The Voynich Manuscript is an illustrated codex believed to date to the early 15th century. Its unknown script and unusual botanical, astronomical and biological illustrations have resisted convincing decipherment.

scenes.narration: A centuries-old book sits in a library, filled with writing nobody has convincingly decoded.

scenes.narration: Its pages contain strange plants that do not clearly match familiar botanical illustrations.

scenes.narration: Other pages depict circular diagrams, stars and unfamiliar astronomical arrangements.

scenes.narration: The text uses a consistent but unknown writing system, and many proposed translations remain unproven.
